page_data.syllabus:
IBA প্যাটার্ন অনুসারে ৮০ মার্কের ফুল মডেল টেস্ট।
[Live MCQ - তে প্রতি মাসের ৪, ১৪ ও ২৪ তারিখে IBA প্যাটার্ন অনুসারে ফুল মডেল টেস্ট অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।]

পরীক্ষা – ২৫
 Subject: English Language and Literature - 5
 টপিক:
i) Name of writers of literary pieces from Romantic Period to Post-Modern Period (Important drama, poetry & prose)

উৎস: এনসাইক্লোপিডিয়া ব্রিটানিকা, ইংরেজি সাহিত্যের উপর যেকোনো স্কলারের লেখা বই (যেমন - ইংরাজি সাহিত্যের ইতিহাস: শীতল ঘোষ), যেকোনো গাইড বই।
[গাইড বই থেকে পড়ার ক্ষেত্রে কনফিউজিং বিষয়গুলো ক্রসচেক করে পড়া উত্তম।]

Exam - 14

Modern Muslim Philosophers:  Shah Waliullah Dehlawi and Muhammad Iqbal.

Indian Philosophy: Buddhism, Sakhya, Naya and Vedanta Schools 

[Source: Class - 09 and Relevant Books]

Exam - 14 

Topics:
(Population dynamics, embryology, economic Zoology) 
Principles of population dynamics 
Human population and its control strategies in Bangladesh and principles of birth control practices. 
Egg  types, fertilization, cleavage types and gastrulation. 
Early imbronic development of Amphioxus 
Culture of carp, prawn and shrimps in Bangladesh.

[Source: Class - 12 and Relevant Books]

Exam 14

Topic:

f. Unification of Italy 
g. The Eastern Question: The Crimean War & Berlin Congress
h. World War I: background and causes; results; Versailles Treaty
i. Rise of socialism in Europe: The Bolshevik Revolution, 
j. Rise of Hitler in Germany & Mussolini in Italy

Source: Class – 8, 9, relevant books

Exam 14

Topic: 
• Use of Social Group Work as a problem-solving process in the context of Bangladesh.
• Scope and importance of Community development in Bangladesh.

Source: Class – 10, relevant books

পরীক্ষা - ১৪

ইসলামে মানবাধিকার: মানবাধিকারের ধারণা: নাগরিক, রাজনৈতিক, সামাজিক, অর্থনৈতিক এবং সাংস্কৃতিক অধিকার, ইসলাম ও দাসত্ব, যুদ্ধকালীন মানবাধিকার, সংখ্যালঘু ধর্মীয় সম্প্রদায় ও নারীদের অধিকার, জাতিসংঘের এতিহাসিক ঘোষণা অনুযায়ী মানবাধিকার অধ্যয়ন। 

[উৎস: লেকচার-১০ ও সংশ্লিষ্ট বই]

Exam-13

Nuclear Physics (Nuclear Structure and Forces, Radioactivity and Reactions)

 [Source: Class‑9 and relevant books]

Exam - 13

Topics:
Horticulture:
1. Classification of fertilizer, composition, doses, application and procedures.
2. Application of growth regulating chemicals in horticulture.

Ethonobotany:
1. Ethno-botanical research in Bangladesh
2.Medicinal plants of Bangladesh, their conservation and sustainable use.

[Source: Class - 11 and Relevant Books]

Exam 14:

Principles of seed crop production (Class 8),

Crop-weed competition (Class 8),

Allelopathic effects of weeds on crops and vice-versa (Class 8).

Exam - 13

Topics:
General procedure for test of hypothesis.
Tests based on normal, student's t, F, and X2 distribution. The Z- test
for two population means. The pooled t-test for two population means.
The paired t-test for two population means.

[Source: Class - 09 and Relevant Books]

Exam - 14

Topics:
Caustic-Chlorine Industries & Plastic Industry

1. Caustic soda-chlorine industry in Bangladesh.
2. Environmental aspects of caustic-chlorine industry.
3. Plastic Industry: Polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride, polymethyl
acrylate, polystyrene.

[Source: Class - 09 and Relevant Books]

Exam 14        

Molecular Biology (Part–1)        

[Source: Class–11 and relevant books]

Exam - 14

Topics:
1. Complex functions, Differentiability, 
2. Cauchy-Riemann equations, Analytic function, Complex integration,

[Source: Class - 14 and Relevant Books]
ফুল মডেল টেস্ট: ব্যাংক নিয়োগের সম্পূর্ণ সিলেবাসের উপর ১০০ নাম্বারের ফুল মডেল টেস্ট। [Live MCQ - তে প্রতি মঙ্গলবার একটি ফুল মডেল টেস্ট অনুষ্ঠিত হয়।]

পরীক্ষা – ১০: 

Full Model Test - 3

Exam - 12
Topics:
E. International Politics of South & South East Asia:
The Region, Social & Cultural
Setting, Historical & Colonial Experience, Nationalist Movement, Nature & Political
System: Democratic Setup, The Foreign Policies of South and South East AsianCountries, The Formation of SAARC, ASEAN, and Future Prospects.

Source: Class - 9 and Relavant Books

Exam 14:

Topic: (part II)

g. Nuruddin Jahangir-his state policy, patronization of art and painting, the influence of Nurjahan in the court;
Shihabuddin Shah Jahan-his administration and architectural development-war of succession among his sons;
Muhiuddin Alamgir Aurangzib-his expansion of the empirestruggle with the Marahtas and Deccan policy-his
revivalist and religious policy; the weak successors of the dynasty and the forces of disintegration; the causes
for the decay and downfall of the dynasty; society, learning, culture and administration in Muhgal India.

Source: Class – 11, relevant books

Exam 14:
Topic: (Part II)

9. Social Problems in Bangladesh (Some selected problems)
9.1 Population problem-causes, consequences & solutions.
9.2 Poverty- causes, consequences & solutions.
9.3 Illiteracy- causes, consequences & solutions.
9.4 Dowry- causes, consequences & solutions.
9.5 Problems of unemployment- causes, consequences & solutions.

Source: Class – 11, relevant books

Exam - 13

Internal audit, internal control-object, procedures of internal audit, position, vouching
verification, valuation of assets and liabilities, auditors’ duties and liabilities.

Source: Class - 9 and Relavant Books
